title: Herd Immunity Is Not Where It Stops
summary: Guess how many people an unmitigated epidemic infects, then watch it sail past the herd immunity threshold and keep going.

sources.title: Kermack and McKendrick, A Contribution to the Mathematical Theory of Epidemics, Proc. R. Soc. A 115, 1927
Miller, A Note on the Derivation of Epidemic Final Sizes, Bull. Math. Biol. 74(9), 2012
